verdict.rationale: Pricing tiers and message-history retention are a fair question for a team chat product like Microsoft Teams, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers a free tier or its message-history limits. The Export API items cover programmatic export of messages and deleted-message access, not free-tier history retention, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can keep my team on a free tier without losing access to older message history
